s.how: Wash and dry 500g strawberries completely, keeping the stalks on. Melt 150g dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water. Dip each berry two-thirds of the way in, let the excess drip off and roll the base in 50g finely chopped pistachios. Lay on baking paper. Melt 50g white chocolate and drizzle over with a fork, then dust with a pinch of crushed freeze-dried raspberry. Chill 20 minutes until set.

s.n: Reed's flower shop goat's cheese toasts
s.note: Reed's flower shop on the busiest day of the year
s.how: Cut 8 hearts from 8 slices sourdough, brush with olive oil and toast at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp. Whip 150g soft goat's cheese with 50g cream cheese until smooth. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes. Spread the toasts with the cheese, drizzle with hot honey, scatter with thyme leaves and finish with a few edible flowers or pomegranate seeds.

m.how: Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, smash flat on a tray, drizzle with oil and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Season 4 sirloin steaks and sear in a hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for 1 minute. Rest the steaks. Add 150ml red wine and 150ml beef stock to the pan and reduce by half. Sauté 300g green beans in butter.

w.how: Beat 115g butter with 200g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then 1 tsp vanilla and 1 tsp red colouring paste. Fold in 200g plain flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tsp bicarb and 160ml buttermilk mixed with 1 tsp vinegar. Divide between 12 cases and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Cool. Beat 200g cream cheese, 60g butter and 250g icing sugar and pipe on. Crumble one cupcake over the rest.

d.note: Kara's I Hate Valentine's Day party
d.how: Drop 3 raspberries into each of 4 flutes. Add 30ml pink grapefruit juice to each glass. Slowly top with chilled sparkling rosé, about 120ml per glass. Rub a small rosemary sprig between your hands and add one to each glass. For anyone not drinking, use pink lemonade instead of rosé.
